guide.ultimatezootaming.start.1.title: Taming an animal
guide.ultimatezootaming.start.1.body:
Craft KIBBLE matching the animal's diet: herbivore, carnivore or piscivore. Three qualities exist; better kibble tames faster.

Feed a wild animal the kibble for its diet. It joins your zoo and receives a random personality TRAIT.

A tamed animal never despawns and takes no damage.
guide.ultimatezootaming.start.2.title: Your first enclosure
guide.ultimatezootaming.start.2.body:
Wall off an area, then click inside with the SURVEYOR STAFF. It detects the shape automatically, even irregular ones.

Assign animals to it by clicking them with the staff.

For pools, the scan goes down to the bottom: the whole water column counts.
guide.ultimatezootaming.start.3.title: Opening the park
guide.ultimatezootaming.start.3.body:
Place a ZOO ENTRANCE: visitors arrive there. The gate is walk-through.

Place a ZOO TREASURY: it collects tickets and pays wages.

The zoo opens at dawn and closes at night, with an evening report.

Without a decent score nobody comes: start with welfare.
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.1.title: Welfare
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.1.body:
Each animal scores 0-100 across five parts:

SPACE (30), HABITAT (25), FOOD (20), COMPANY (15), HEALTH (10).

Prolonged misery makes an animal sick.
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.2.title: Habitats
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.2.body:
Every species prefers certain ground, plants, water and biome.

Boss computer, Direction tab, HABITATS button shows what each of your species wants.

A well-themed enclosure raises habitat score and ambiance, so attendance.
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.3.title: Feeding
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.3.body:
Place a FEEDER in the enclosure and fill it with FODDER of the right diet.

Animals come on their own. One feeder serves everyone within 8 blocks.

A FEEDER keeper refills them: he looks in an enclosure chest, then the break room, then a locker that actually holds the fodder.
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.4.title: Illness and care
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.4.body:
Misery leads to mild illness, then severe, then death risk.

REMEDY cures mild illness, SUPER REMEDY severe.

A VET treats his enclosures automatically. If he cannot reach the animal, he is placed beside it on dry ground.

Particles above an animal show its state.
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.5.title: Animal record
guide.ultimatezootaming.animals.5.body:
Right-click an animal with the DIRECTOR TABLET: its full record opens and it gets a cuddle (+5 satisfaction, every 5 minutes).

The record shows trait, welfare in stars, arrival day, times healed, babies, best friend, rarity and generation.

A named NAME TAG christens an animal.
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.1.title: Marking out a zone
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.1.body:
SURVEYOR STAFF: click inside an enclosed space, it follows the shape. Recommended.

PLOT SELECTOR: click two opposite corners for a rectangle.

Enclosures count as VOLUME: 4 blocks below ground, 40 above.
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.2.title: Zone types
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.2.body:
ENCLOSURE: for animals.

BREAK ROOM: dormitory AND storage. Put beds there so staff sleep, and chests so they fetch fodder.

SALES ZONE: the commercial area.

Change the type from the dashboard, Type button.
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.3.title: Ambiance
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.3.body:
Each enclosure scores 0-10 on ambiance: flowers, foliage, tall trees, lanterns, ice, water, nearby benches.

Good average ambiance raises attendance by up to 40%.

Watch out: LITTER on the ground costs up to 4 points.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.1.title: The six jobs
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.1.body:
GENERALIST: a bit of everything.
VET: heals the sick.
FEEDER: fills feeders.
GUARD: contains escapes, patrols.
VENDOR: runs registers and fetches stock.
JANITOR: picks up litter.

Change job from the dashboard, button right of the name.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.2.title: Hiring and wages
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.2.body:
Boss computer, Recruitment tab: three candidates a day with job, skill stars and cost.

Wages come out of the TOTAL treasury at closing time.

Empty till means strike. A striking employee does nothing until paid.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.3.title: Up to 3 enclosures
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.3.body:
Select an enclosure, then click an employee's name to add or remove it. The counter shows 1/3, 2/3, 3/3.

With several enclosures he does a ROUND. Illness makes that enclosure top priority.

An unassigned feeder covers the whole park.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.4.title: Experience and skills
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.4.body:
Work earns XP: 2 per heal, 1 per refill, sale or litter picked. 50 XP per level, up to level 20.

One skill point every 2 levels.

Boss computer, Direction tab, STAFF button: your registry. Click someone to open their sheet.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.5.title: The six skills
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.5.body:
SWIFTNESS: +8% speed per rank.
REACH: +2 blocks working radius.
EFFICIENCY: -20% cooldown.
DEDICATION: tolerates 1 unpaid day per rank.
STAMINA: works longer.
MASTERY: job-specific bonus.

Three ranks each. Reset returns spent points.
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.1.title: The visit
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.1.body:
A visitor only leaves after seeing ALL your enclosures.

In between he may stop at a kiosk, buy a souvenir, sit down when tired, drink or eat when needed.

His pace is rolled at spawn: hurried, normal or contemplative.
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.2.title: Needs and mood
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.2.body:
THIRST and HUNGER: he looks for a stand, and complains if there is none.
FATIGUE: he looks for a bench.

Emotes appear above his head: heart, droplet, smoke, sparkles.

In the rain he takes out his umbrella.
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.3.title: Personalities and groups
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.3.body:
Each visitor has a type: standard, photographer, bird fan, family, lone child or celebrity.

One in three arrives with company. Children follow the group leader.

Visitors passing each other may stop for a short chat.
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.4.title: Reviews
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.4.body:
Visitors comment on what they experience: beauty, cleanliness, crowding, prices, signage, staff friendliness, animal condition.

Boss computer, Reviews tab: the last 30 reviews in stars, their average, and the TOP 5 species VIPs are asking for.
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.1.title: The Park Ticket
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.1.body:
The zoo currency is the PARK TICKET.

The ZOO TREASURY collects entries and sales and pays wages. Several treasuries add up: any withdrawal draws on the total.

Right-click with tickets to deposit, or use the withdraw buttons.
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.2.title: Opening a shop
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.2.body:
Place a CASH REGISTER on a counter. Sneak + empty-hand click changes its type: souvenirs, meals, ice cream, drinks, photos.

NO SALES WITHOUT A VENDOR within 3 blocks.

Click the register holding an item to price it. ANY modpack item can be sold.
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.3.title: Prices and stock
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.3.body:
Dashboard, Shops tab: click a shop to see its items. The + and - buttons set each price. An unpriced item shows red and is not sold.

Place a CHEST within 5 blocks: when stock runs low the vendor fetches from it.

Visitors judge price against need and say so.
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.4.title: Exchange and recycling
guide.ultimatezootaming.money.4.body:
TREASURY, EXCHANGE COUNTER button: turn tickets into ores. Coal 3, iron 8, gold 18, diamond 45, netherite 400.

RECYCLE button: 8 recyclable waste gives 5 tickets. Cleaning up genuinely pays.
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.1.title: Zoo ranks
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.1.body:
Your zoo ranks up on cumulative visitors, species and score:

Starter, Local, Regional, National, Prestigious, World-class.

Each rank raises the visitor cap and ticket price, and pays a promotion bonus.
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.2.title: Daily missions
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.2.body:
Three missions drawn daily from twelve: welcome visitors, heal, sell, photograph, feed, cuddle, hire and more.

Boss computer, Direction tab, DAILY MISSIONS button. A bar shows progress and the reward is claimed on completion.
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.3.title: Ad campaigns
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.3.body:
Computer, Direction tab, MARKETING button.

Local: 50, 3 days, +30%.
Regional: 150, 4 days, +50%.
National: 350, 5 days, +80%.
Worldwide: 800, 7 days, +150%.

Big campaigns need a high rank. One at a time.
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.4.title: Daily events
guide.ultimatezootaming.progress.4.body:
Each morning an event may occur:

JOURNALIST: bonus if your score tops 60 by evening.
INSPECTION: bonus with no sick animals.
SCHOOL TRIP: chaperones and many children.
CELEBRITY: a VIP wants a rare species.
OUTAGE: kiosks are down.
PROTEST: fewer visitors.
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.1.title: Having a baby
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.1.body:
Feed two tamed adults of the same species their diet kibble: they fall in love and breed.

The baby is tamed and assigned to its parents' enclosure.

The INCUBATOR does it automatically: place it near an enclosure holding two or more animals of a species.
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.2.title: Inheritance and mutation
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.2.body:
The baby inherits a parent's trait 6 times out of 10, a random trait 3 times out of 10.

Once in 10 there is a MUTATION: guaranteed special trait and rarity up one step.

Mutations are announced to all players.
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.3.title: Rarity and bloodlines
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.3.body:
Four rarities: common, SILVER, GOLDEN, ALBINO.

A baby inherits the better rarity of its parents, so breed your rarest together to climb.

GENERATION rises with each captive birth, and the record keeps its parents.
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.1.title: Cleanliness
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.1.body:
A visitor finishing a drink looks for a BIN within 8 blocks. Finding none, he drops it.

Litter costs up to 4 ambiance points and triggers negative reviews.

Pick it up by right-clicking, or let a JANITOR patrol. Each piece yields a recyclable.
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.2.title: Ticketing
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.2.body:
Place one or more TICKET BOOTHS near your entrance.

Once a booth exists, visitors arrive beside it and must buy a ticket before doing anything. They queue, three at a time per booth.

More booths, more throughput. Without booths everything works as before.
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.3.title: Paths and map
guide.ultimatezootaming.upkeep.3.body:
The ZOO MAP shows the park from above.

TERRITORY mode: claim chunks. They stay loaded, so animals and staff keep living while you are away.

PATHS mode: declare which blocks act as walkways. Visitors prefer them. Slabs, stairs and Zoo Path are recognised by default.

guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.4.title: Enriching an enclosure
guide.ultimatezootaming.zones.4.body:
Four TOYS to place in enclosures: Play Ball, Hanging Bamboo, Climbing Branch, Hanging Tire.

Each adds 3 habitat points, up to four toys per enclosure. A well-equipped enclosure can reach the maximum habitat score.

They are walk-through: an animal never gets stuck on them.
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.6.title: An employee's day
guide.ultimatezootaming.staff.6.body:
Every employee carries their job's TOOL: a vial for the vet, fodder for the feeder, a whistle for the guard, tickets for the vendor, a sack for the janitor.

Their day has a rhythm: taking post at dawn, lunch break around midday in the break room, returning at end of service.

An emergency (sick animal, escape) always interrupts the routine.

Unpaid, they join the other strikers in front of the Treasury and show their anger.
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.5.title: What visitors carry
guide.ultimatezootaming.visitors.5.body:
One visitor in six arrives equipped, one in two among photographers.

BINOCULARS: they watch each enclosure 2 seconds longer.
SELFIE STICK: they photograph themselves and share the shot.

In the Souvenir shop, one buyer in three leaves wearing a ZOO CAP, which stays on their head for the rest of the visit.

A running child may LOSE THEIR BALLOON: it really flies away and the child cries.
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.4.title: The gene bank
guide.ultimatezootaming.breeding.4.body:
The SAMPLING SYRINGE takes a GENETIC SAMPLE from a tamed animal (right-click). The sample keeps its species, trait, rarity and generation.

Insert TWO samples of the same species into the Incubator: it broods for about a minute, then a baby hatches with both donors' heritage.

The point: crossing two animals that will never meet, and keeping the DNA of an exceptional beast even after its death.

An animal can only be sampled once a minute.
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.1.title: International contracts
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.1.body:
Foreign zoos request animals. Boss computer, Direction tab, CONTRACTS button.

They only ask for species you already own. Four requirement levels: any individual, a healthy adult, a baby from your breeding, or a rare specimen.

The higher the requirement, the bigger the reward and prestige.
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.2.title: Delivering an animal
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.2.body:
The screen lists animals meeting the conditions, with welfare in stars.

Click Deliver and the animal leaves for its new zoo. You get tickets and PRESTIGE, which counts as cumulative visitors and raises your rank.

Beware: a delivered animal is gone for good. Think before sending your only golden specimen.
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.3.title: ZooTok, the social feed
guide.ultimatezootaming.renown.3.body:
Right-click empty air with the DIRECTOR TABLET.

When a visitor rests on a bench, they pull out their phone and post. Happy, they praise the enclosure; unhappy, they complain about prices, dirt or crowds.

Recent posts gather likes each day. The feed produces an attendance multiplier between 70% and 140%.

Bad buzz fades within three days if you fix the problem. Place benches: without them, nobody posts.
